english.title: Use vehicle on a road with front / rear position lamps obscured

(D)_[front position]_
(E)_[rear position]_

(F)_[lamp]_

english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 19 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.

Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)

english.notes:
(i) The meaning of "every movable part" is 'every door, tailgate, boot lid, engine cover, cab or other moveable part'.
(ii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iii) See also offence wordings: H3078, H3079, H3080, H3081, H3082, H3083, H3085 and H3086.
(iv) Fixed penalty scheme may be applied

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale if in respect of goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers.

A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale in any other case.

Fixed penalty ticket - Fifty pounds.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
